headline: 🇩🇪 Suspected Qilin payload developer extradited from Japan to Germany, 🚔 FBI arrests ransomware-negotiation firm co-founder in ShinyHunters probe, 🔥 SonicWall SMA1000 CVSS 10.0 SSRF exploited days after patch, 💾 AhsayCBS zero-day chain hits five orgs with web shells and XMRig, 🤖 AgentCorruption single-prompt AWS agent takeover, 🐦 Telegram Desktop one-click account takeover PoC public
summary: Law enforcement leads the day with Germany's confirmed custody of a suspected Qilin core member and an FBI arrest inside the ransomware-negotiation world, while defenders face same-week exploitation of freshly patched SonicWall SMA1000 and AhsayCBS backup flaws, a public Telegram Desktop takeover PoC, and a single-prompt attack chain against AWS Bedrock AgentCore.
